description: Soljo Data: full solar profile for one Swiss building from official data. Returns the roof faces (Sonnendach, BFE), building facts from the federal register (construction period, floors, heating energy source), measured shading from the swisstopo LiDAR surface model, system size and annual yield, and the economics: turnkey cost, subsidies, local electricity price (ElCom), feed-in tariff, self-consumption, savings, payback and 25-year net result. Same calculation as the Soljo report. Every value block lists sourceIds that resolve to `sources`; cite them. Without api_key a small shared free allowance applies; a free key with 100 profiles per month: https://soljo.ch/developers. Takes about 2 to 5 seconds.

address.description: Swiss street address with house number and postcode, e.g. 'Bundesplatz 3, 3011 Bern'.

annual_consumption_kwh.description: Known annual electricity consumption in kWh; overrides household_size.

battery.description: Include a battery recommendation and its payback.

ev.description: Household has or plans an electric car.

heat_pump.description: Household has or plans a heat pump.

household_size.description: People in the household (default 3); drives consumption and self-consumption.
